actions.description: Reset the simulated world to a scenario start state and return the initial observation. When a seed is supplied the endpoint records it in the receipt; otherwise the endpoint's declared default seed applies.

facts.text: RoboCasaEnv is a Gymnasium environment (class RoboCasaEnv(gym.Env))
The wrapper creates the underlying simulation with robosuite.make(**env_kwargs)
The wrapper sets ignore_done=True when it builds the robosuite environment
The action space is a Dict of per-part Box spaces with low -1 and high 1, plus a Discrete(2) base_mode for a hybrid mobile base
step pops every per-part action from the dict, concatenates the per-robot arrays and asserts that no action key remains
step returns the observation, reward, done, truncated=False and info
reset calls np.random.seed(seed) before env.reset()
reset returns the observation and info with success and grasp_distractor_obj set false
get_basic_observation flips the image rows and casts every non-image observation to float32
GrootRoboCasaEnv derives its observation space from the robot key converter and adds a Box(0, 255) of shape (256, 256, 3) for each mapped camera
GrootRoboCasaEnv adds a Text annotation of at most 256 characters and derives its action space from the robot key converter
get_groot_observation maps hand.* and body.* keys to state.* and raises ValueError for any other key
GrootRoboCasaEnv.step unmaps the action, calls the parent step and maps the observation back
The Groot observation uses annotation.human.coarse_action with an unlocked_waist prefix for G1ArmsAndWaist
The G1 arms-and-waist converter maps left_hand, right_hand, left_arm, right_arm and waist, and unmap_action reads them as action.<part> keys
The same converter configures the egoview, rs_view and worldview cameras at 1280 by 800
deduce_action_space makes an integer action member a Discrete(2) and an array member a Box with low -1 and high 1 of the array length
The repository example creates the environment id g1_unified/EvalPnPAppleToPlate_G1ArmsAndWaistDex31Hands_Env
The repository example steps the G1 arms-and-waist environment with action arrays of 7 (left and right hand), 7 (left and right arm) and 3 (waist) elements
The G1 arms-and-waist alias maps the robot class G1ArmsAndWaistDex31Hands to g1_arms_waist_dex31_hands
make_key_converter selects G1ArmsAndWaistKeyConverter for the G1 arms-and-waist robot names
The wrapper registers every registered robosuite environment for every Groot robot alias and adds g1_unified ids for the g1_arms_waist_dex31_hands alias
Tabletop's constructor defaults control_freq to 20 Hz and horizon to 1000
Tabletop forwards control_freq to the robosuite environment
render returns the cached observation frame and refuses before a reset or step; close delegates to the inner environment

determinism.notes: the driver records a seed and passes it to GrootRoboCasaEnv.reset, which calls np.random.seed(seed) before the robosuite reset (gymnasium_basic.py:223-225); the fake draws its placeholder state with Python's random.Random, so one seed repeats on the fake but gives different numbers than the upstream numpy stream, and no trajectory of the two was compared

gaps: no dynamics: the fake integrates a placeholder low-pass motion of five part arrays and has no MuJoCo, robosuite, rigid-body, contact, friction, controller, actuator, sensor or noise model; the upstream wrapper would be an F1 MuJoCo model, not this

the fake always returns reward 0.0 and terminated/truncated False, mirroring the wrapper's ignore_done=True (gymnasium_basic.py:69) and truncated=False (gymnasium_basic.py:256); the concrete task's success test and reward are not modelled

the fake returns 2x2x3 placeholder camera arrays for the four video.* keys whereas the observation space declares 256x256x3 (gymnasium_groot.py:20,29-30) and the cameras capture 1280x800 (robocasa/models/robots/__init__.py:374); the part state and action lengths follow the repository example (test_env.py:25-33) and are placeholders for the live controller dimensions

the five action arrays are the G1ArmsAndWaist converter's part names from the repository example; the live action space is built from reconstruct_latest_actions(env) at runtime and the controller dimensions are not in this clone

the fake draws the initial state with Python's random.Random and upstream with numpy's generator, so one seed gives different numbers on the two; reset without a seed reuses the recorded seed here while upstream np.random.seed(None) draws fresh entropy
task scenes and objects need robosuite_g1, the tabletop assets and MuJoCo (README.md:29-42), which were not installed or downloaded here
snapshot and restore are not offered: GrootRoboCasaEnv exposes no get_state/set_state pair
no sim or hardware backend is declared; the real wrapper path needs robocasa imported to register the gym id, robosuite_g1, MuJoCo and the tabletop assets, and was not run
no physical device is modelled and the simulator was never validated against one
